from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityRecord(BaseModel):
    """Data extracted from one Common Data Set document regarding enrollment and graduation rates."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    total_undergraduate_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Total number of undergraduate students")
    total_graduate_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Total number of graduate students")
    six_year_graduation_rate: float | None = Field(description="The 6-year graduation rate as a percentage (e.g., 73.5 for 73.5%)")
    cohort_year: str | None = Field(description="The cohort year associated with the graduation rate (e.g., Fall 2015)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_records: list[UniversityRecord]
